statutory_dues.text:
In respect of statutory dues:


(a)  The Company has generally been regular in depositing undisputed statutory dues, including Goods and Service tax, Provident Fund, Employees State Insurance, Income-tax, cess and other material statutory dues applicable to the Company. Considering the nature of the operation of the Company, Sales Tax, Duty of Custom, duty of Excise, Value Added Tax, are not applicable to the Company.


There were no undisputed amounts payable in respect of Goods and Service tax, Provident Fund, Employees State Insurance, Income-tax, cess and other material statutory dues in arrears as at March 31, 2026 for a period of more than six months from the date they became payable.

operating_notes.text: Operational portfolio crossed 10 mn sq ft as of April 2026; total footprint ~15.3 mn sq ft across 63 centres in 15 cities in India and Singapore as on December 31, 2025.
Mature centres operated at ~93% committed occupancy in Q3FY26, when revenue was ~₹472 crore, up ~34% year-on-year.
As on March 31, 2026, ₹304.78 Cr of the ₹445 Cr IPO was utilised, ₹140.22 Cr unutilised; fit-out capex object ₹225.84 Cr had ₹133.48 Cr left to spend.
20 May 2026: existing capacity 13.7 mn sq ft leased (10.1 mn sq ft operational) at 31 March 2026, with operational utilisation at 82%.
20 May 2026: 4,02,200 sq ft Gurugram addition to be completed within May 2026 at about ₹60 Cr, funded by internal accruals or issue proceeds.
Mar-2026: total SBA 16.1 Msf (369k seats), operational 10.1 Msf (231k seats) at 88% committed occupancy; mature centres 93% committed on 8.9 Msf.
Mar-2026: contracted rental revenue of ₹52,139 Mn over unexpired lease terms against committed rentals to landlords of ₹15,927 Mn on the operational footprint.
FY26: top 10 clients were 20% of rental revenue (39% in FY19); IT/ITeS ~35% of portfolio; 1,000+ seat cohort 37% of rental revenue.
27 May 2026: 4,92,661 sq ft Bengaluru addition to be completed within May 2026 at about ₹70 Cr, funded by internal accruals or issue proceeds.
Mar-2026: existing capacity 13.7 mn sq ft leased (operational + fitout + yet to be handover) and 10.1 mn sq ft operational at 82% utilisation.
Smartworks leased a ~4.92 lakh sq. ft. campus at Sattva Aura on the Outer Ring Road in Bengaluru.
Smartworks leased over 400 seats to a Japanese NBFC subsidiary in Mumbai for a five-year tenure generating ~₹35 Cr rental revenue.
Committed occupancy of mature centres stands at 92%
Seat retention was 74% for the quarter
Value-added services revenue increased to ₹68 Cr from ₹22 Cr in Q1FY26
Accumulated losses stood at ₹385.62 Cr as on 31 March 2026, to be fully set off against securities premium of ₹798.22 Cr if NCLT sanctions the reduction.

timeline.summary: 21 April 2026: Smartworks said its operational portfolio crossed 10 mn sq ft after the Tata Intellion Park centre in Mumbai went operational, against a total footprint of ~15.3 mn sq ft.
Smartworks Q4 FY26 revenue rises to ₹506.63 Cr; net profit at ₹15.02 Cr
30 April 2026: CARE Ratings' monitoring report showed Smartworks had utilised ₹304.78 Cr of its ₹445 Cr IPO by March 2026, with ₹140.22 Cr unutilised and no deviation from objects.
Smartworks Coworking Spaces Limited disclosed the audio recording of its analyst meet on April 30, 2026, discussing FY2026 results at 04:00 PM (IST).
20 May 2026: Smartworks said it added 4,02,200 sq ft in Gurugram for about ₹60 Cr, funded from internal accruals or issue proceeds, on a 10.1 mn sq ft operational base that was 82% utilised.
22 May 2026: Smartworks' investor presentation showed Q4FY26 revenue up 45% YoY to ₹519.7 Cr, reported PAT of ₹16.6 Cr, net-debt-negative balance sheet and RoCE of 22%.

27 May 2026: Smartworks said it would add 4,92,661 sq ft in Bengaluru within May 2026 at about ₹70 Cr, funded from internal accruals or issue proceeds, on a 10.1 mn sq ft operational base at 82% utilisation.
On May 27, 2026, Smartworks announced a ~4.92 lakh sq ft office lease at Sattva Aura in Bengaluru.
On May 28, 2026, CARE Ratings reaffirmed Smartworks Coworking's long-term bank facilities at CARE A; Stable and short-term facilities at CARE A1.
On June 8, 2026, Smartworks announced a five-year lease for over 400 seats in Mumbai to a Japanese NBFC subsidiary, generating ~₹35 Cr in rental revenue.
Smartworks reported Q1FY27 results with revenue up 44% YoY to ₹546 Cr and reaffirmed FY27 guidance of 28-30% revenue growth and 19-20% EBITDA margin.
On 14 October 2026, Smartworks e-filed Form RSC-1 with the NCLT New Delhi Bench seeking sanction to set off ₹385.62 Cr of accumulated losses against its securities premium account.
Q2FY27 results (consolidated): revenue ₹591.37 Cr (+39.2% YoY), net profit ₹25.64 Cr (against a loss of ₹3.14 Cr a year earlier).
Smartworks Coworking Spaces Limited shared the audio recording of its analyst meet discussing unaudited Q2FY27 results (ended Sep 30, 2026) on Oct 30, 2026, at 1:30 PM IST.
